events.quote: The IPF Executive Committee voted, unanimously, starting on January 01, 2025, all Head Coaches, nominated for an International, International Regional, or World Championship, will be required to upload their Coach License into the Goodlift System.
events.value_after: Head Coaches ved internationale mesterskaber skal uploade coachlicens i Goodlift

events.quote: Dette primært fordi IPF-uddannelsen bliver et krav fra 1.1.2026 for alle Head Coaches.
events.value_after: IPF-træneruddannelse er krav for alle Head Coaches
